name: FLCC - BOTR Church Network
vision: We envision FLCC as a family of prayer and worshippers raised up from its own harvest of born-again believers, discipled and trained to maturity, committed to multiply themselves into the lives of others, guided by the Great Commandment and mobilised for the fulfillment of the Great Commission.
purpose: Ang FLCC ay naitatag sa pamamagitan ng biyaya ng Diyos at sa kapangyarihan ng Banal na Espiritu, upang akayin ang mga Pilipino sa Kuwait tungo sa pagkilala kay Hesus at maging bahagi ng Kanyang sambahayan, palaguin sila sa kanilang pananampalataya sa ikauunlad ng Iglesya upang sa kanilang paghayo sa mundo ay maitaas at maluwalhati ang pangalan ng Panginoong Jesus.
statementOfFaith: We believe that the Holy Bible is the inspired and infallible and authoritative Word of God. We believe that there is only one God, eternally existent in three persons; Father, Son and the Holy Spirit. We believe the deity of the Lord Jesus Christ, in His virgin birth, His sinless life, His miracles, and His vicarious and atoning death through His shedding of the blood, in His bodily resurrection, His ascension to the right hand of the Father and His personal return in power and glory. We believe that man fell through disobedience but Christ died to redeem us. We believe that repentance from sin and acceptance of the Lord Jesus is vital. We believe that salvation can only be achieved by grace through faith. We believe that the new birth should be experienced to become a child of God. We believe in the doctrine of sanctification. We believe in the ordinances set by the Lord, water baptism by immersion and the Lord's Supper. We believe in the baptism of the Holy Spirit with speaking of tongues as initial evidence. We believe in the Spirit filled life and the gifts and fruits of the Holy Spirit. We believe in the divine healing. We believe that the second coming of the Lord Jesus Christ is imminent and personal. We believe in the resurrection of both of the saved and the lost, resurrection unto life and resurrection unto damnation respectively. We believe in the final judgement. We believe in heaven and hell and the coming new heaven and the new earth. Amen
missionTarget: Introduce 270,000 people to Jesus Christ by 2030
